_comment: KF-vs-EKF demonstration: HIGH velocity (7 m/s initial) under quadratic drag (k=0.5). 30-frame run keeps the action at velocities where the model mismatch is large (per-frame Δvel ≈ k*v² scales with v²). Amplitude tuned to Pd ≈ 0.3-0.4 with --max-coast 15 to allow 3-5 frame coast streaks. During such streaks at v≈5 bins/frame, KF predicts ~25 bins ahead while EKF (drag) predicts ~15 bins ahead — a ~10-bin (40 cm) gap that should be visible at plot scale.
